story.title: Global edtech funding collapses as investors pivot from K-12 apps to AI workforce training
story.summary: Venture capital funding for K-12 education technology has dropped sharply worldwide, with investors redirecting capital toward AI-powered workforce training platforms that promise faster and more measurable returns. The shift is leaving school-focused edtech startups in emerging markets particularly exposed, as they had relied on international VC to reach underserved students. Rest of World's analysis shows the funding reorientation is accelerating a two-tier global education technology landscape.
